title: No fast travel exists to interior waypoint rooms inside a hold (only major named landmarks register for 'travel to a known place'), so finding a specific unlabeled connector -- the path from Cinderhall's head-frame through the spoil-heap maze to 'The High Cut' into the Kingswood -- took roughly 15 turns of manual N/S/E/W trial-and-error with repeated free bearings checks and no map/compass pointer at the connector itself.
where: Iron Downs, head-frame spoil-heaps -> The High Cut
